unidentified_groups.label: Transfers to third parties
unidentified_groups.reason: The description records a transfer to a third party, without naming the recipient. Its payment wording and reference remain available.

unidentified_groups.label: Bank transfers with no named recipient
unidentified_groups.reason: The description identifies the transfer route or bank, but no beneficiary name. A bank name alone is not treated as the recipient.

unidentified_groups.label: Returned transfers
unidentified_groups.reason: The description records a returned transfer. It does not name the original beneficiary; compare its reference with the outgoing payment.
